summary: Umpqua NF lookout near Tiller, Oregon: L-4 cab built 1940 on Diamond Rock, abandoned 1941, removed 1968 (or 1969); no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 14 x 14 ft L-4 cab (Rex's page); register describes a ground L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Removed in 1968 per the register; firelookout.com says destroyed 1968; Rex's page lists 1969

staffing.status: lookouts recorded 1929, 1935, 1941, 1942, 1944 and 1962; register says restaffed about 18 years after 1941; no end-of-staffing date in these sources

events.note: Eddie Hamlin, the lookout, handled a fire in a cabin near the station (Glendale Log item quoted on Rex's page)
Sources disagree on the first structure: a rag camp (register) or an Aladdin gable-roofed lookout house (Rex's page)

George Hunt on duty during an August 1962 earthquake; no damage to the lookout reported
Rex's page lists removal in 1969; conflicts with 1968

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says a rag camp; Rex's page says an Aladdin gable-roofed lookout house. Both agree the L-4 cab followed in 1940, so the story reports the disagreement and does not choose one.
The register and firelookout.com say 1968; Rex's page says 1969. The story gives 1968 with the register's date and notes Rex's different year.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 36.6 (120 ft) matches Rex's '120-foot high Diamond Rock', which describes the rock, not a tower; the register says a 100-foot rock pillar. Tower height omitted from facts. Removal year conflicts (1968 vs 1969). The 1959 restaffing year is derived from 'restaffed 18 years later'. No source describes the site or its access today; the 2008 register photo's content is not described and was not viewed. Brief access 'unknown' left as is. No photos added.
